content: Hi! How can I help you today?

- Date of birth  
- Email address on file  
- Phone number on file  
- Mailing address on file  

Once I have that information, I’ll be able to check your Platinum Rewards Card eligibility for the annual‑fee rebate.
Of course! My date of birth is 05/12/1991, and my mailing address is 3421 Sakura Avenue, Portland, OR 97205. Let me know if you need anything else.

Thank you for providing those details. To complete the verification, could you also share either the email address or phone number associated with your Rho‑Bank account (whichever is most convenient for you)? This will allow me to match the information in our system and proceed with checking your rebate eligibility.
Sure! The email address associated with my Rho-Bank account is yuki.nakamura@email.com. Let me know if you need anything else to verify my identity.
